object.name: evi_DAHDSHR
object.digest: ADSR envelope generator, similar features to MSP <o>adsr~</o> but with logarithmic segments
object.description: ADSR by default, but actually DAHDSHR capabale generator via attributes. Logarithmic segment shapes but still capable of controlling <o>poly~</o> and <o>thispoly~</o>, and other sample accurate processes in <o>gen~</o>. See <o>evi.adsr~</o> for an MSP version.

constructor.inlets: gate, delay, attack, hold1, decay, sustain, hold2, release

inlets.name: gate
inlets.digest: Non-zero triggers the envelope, which will sustain until a zero is received or another non-zero is received.

inlets.name: delay
inlets.digest: Initial delay time before the attack segment of the envelope, default in ms, but units dependent upon the @timebase attribute.

inlets.name: attack
inlets.digest: Attack time, default in ms, but units dependent upon the @timebase attribute.

inlets.name: hold1
inlets.digest: Time for first hold segment, between attack and decay, default in ms, but units dependent upon the @timebase attribute.

inlets.name: decay
inlets.digest: Decay time, default in ms, but units dependent upon the @timebase attribute.

inlets.name: sustain
inlets.digest: Sustain level, default in linear amplitude, but units dependent upon the @sustainbase attribute.

inlets.name: hold2
inlets.digest: Time for second hold segment, between sustain and release, default in ms, but units dependent upon the @timebase attribute.

inlets.name: release
inlets.digest: Release time, default in ms, but units dependent upon the @timebase attribute.

outlets.name: dahdshr
outlets.digest: (d)A(h)DS(h)R envelope generator output with logarithmic segments.

outlets.name: new
outlets.digest: Trigger up on new envelope, trigger down on beginning of release stage.

outlets.name: active
outlets.digest: Active off (0, envelope is innactive) or on (1, envelope is active).

attributes.name: envmax
attributes.description: Expected maximum of input to left trigger inlet. This can be any value, by default it assumes velocity. Only used if the @velocitysense attribute is > 0

attributes.name: fallratio
attributes.description: Ratio 0..10, minimum -120dB. Ratio 0..10, very exponential..almost linear.

attributes.name: legato
attributes.description: Flag 0/1, start from current value if reattacking active envelope (rather than ramping to zero).

attributes.name: retrigger
attributes.description: Time in ms, fade to 0 in x ms if reattacking active envelope.

attributes.name: riseratio
attributes.description: Ratio 0..10, minimum -120dB, ratio 0..10, very logarithmic..almost linear.

attributes.name: sustainbase
attributes.description: Flag 0/1, select the units used to control the 'sustain' inlet. 0=linear gain (default), 1=dB.

attributes.name: timebase
attributes.description: Flag 0/1, select the units used to control all time base inputs. 0=samples, 1=ms (default).

attributes.name: velocitycurve
attributes.description: Type -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, velocity in curve, positive=log, 0=lin, negative=exp.

attributes.name: velocitysense
attributes.description: Normalised 0..1, velocity sensitivity 0..1 (<m>envmax</m> is only used if this > 0.).

attributes.name: wait
attributes.description: Flag 0/1, wait until envelope 0 before allowing reattack of active envelope.
